review_packet.packet_title: Synthetic Review Packet With Education Adaptation Cards

education_adaptation_cards.title: Teacher Adaptation Card
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Help a teacher turn the review packet into a source-bound lesson plan without adding unsupported claims.

source_binding.blocked_claims_policy: Do not introduce claims that are absent from the review packet source ledger.

adaptation_actions: Extract learning objectives from packet claims already tied to source IDs.
Flag any proposed classroom context that needs teacher review.

risks.risk_text: Lesson framing could overgeneralize from a draft packet.
risks.mitigation: Require teacher/editor approval before classroom use.

outputs.description: Draft-only lesson outline attached to review packet.

education_adaptation_cards.title: Student Adaptation Card
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Convert the packet into student-facing prompts while preserving source limitations and uncertainty markers.

source_binding.blocked_claims_policy: Prompts may ask questions, but cannot state new facts beyond packet sources.

adaptation_actions: Rewrite key claims as discussion questions.

risks.risk_text: Students may treat draft packet claims as settled facts.
risks.mitigation: Preserve draft-only labels and include source-check questions.

education_adaptation_cards.title: Assessment and Gate Card
education_adaptation_cards.purpose: Gate the teacher/student cards before they are allowed into an internal review packet release.

source_binding.blocked_claims_policy: Fail the gate if the card contains factual claims without packet source support.

adaptation_actions: Check source coverage for every factual claim.
Check that teacher and student outputs remain draft-only.

risks.risk_text: Education cards could be rendered without an explicit gate result.
risks.mitigation: Require this assessment_gate_card before packet integration.

review_notes: Gate is a mock contract; no automated pedagogical approval implied.

assessment_gates.gate_name: Source support present for every claim
evidence_required: Source ledger IDs for all factual claims
